subject: Air freight quote: MUC to PVG
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well! Could you quote the fastest air freight option from MUC to PVG (Shanghai, CN) for us?

We’ll deliver the shipment to MUC ourselves, so there’s no need to arrange pickup. It’ll be ready on 2026-11-28. We have 9 pieces of textile samples, with a gross weight of 134 kg and a total volume of 0.77 cbm.

Could you send me your all-in price in EUR, along with the drop-off cutoff and expected arrival at PVG?

Thanks for checking!

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG
